notes: Defines Condition R after cancelling the name pi0-rigide: every open subgroup over a local base containing the closed fibre is the whole group. Finite type over locally noetherian base allows DVR testing. Corollary: subgroup section functor is a closed subprescheme of S when X satisfies R. Cancelled example concerns centralizers, normalizers and transporters; an inserted separatedness qualifier is attached around Cent/Norm. Track later replacement before treating as retained claim.
